title: Automatic task to model attachment
root_cause: The existing rank_models primitive has no production caller that joins task semantics, capability package, inventory, and exact model attachment.
source_requirement: Select and attach a model automatically from the canonical task plan, semantic profile, ranking, inventory, and policy.
implementation_steps: Adapt rank_models into the plan compiler.
Filter by semantic/task, privacy, context, modality, and tool needs.
Persist ranking reasons and chosen attachment in the plan.
negative_cases: Ranking result not carried into plan.
affected_tests: Routing, local model runtime, task plan, provider tests.
evidence_required: End-to-end task-to-attachment receipt with exact artifact binding.
rollback: Return plan model attachment to unresolved and retain prior explicit model selection.
acceptance_criteria: A production path invokes canonical ranking.
The selected exact attachment is part of the immutable task plan.
